verdict.rationale: The service's pages say only that using the Guichet unique is free and that any charges come from court-registry (greffe) and Bodacc publication fees. They publish no actual amounts for those statutory fees, so the founder cannot see the exact cost of a transaction. Payment-method details (card, payment delegation) describe how to pay, not how much.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form

citations.quote: Si des frais sont demandés, ils sont liés aux frais de greffe et de publication au Bodacc
